name: asad-gohar-marketplace
description: Asad Gohar's studio for LinkedIn — a Claude Code plugin that renders emerald, circuit-board image stills and short videos scored with local music. One brief, three canvases (square, portrait, story), everything rendered on the machine.

plugins.name: asad-gohar-studio
plugins.description: Render an image still (insight/list/stat/quote/showcase) or a short video with music — emerald on near-black, circuit-board background, Inter. Square 1080x1080, portrait 1080x1350 or story 1080x1920 from the same brief. Stills at 4x, video at 2x, all local via Remotion.
